legacyText.title: Speedboat and Ferry from Koh Lanta | Secret Travel & Tour
intro: Boats leave from Saladan pier. We book your seat and arrange the hotel pickup on Koh Lanta, at a time that depends on your beach.
Tell us your route, your date and how many of you travel, and we reply with the fare.
legacyText.cardDescription: Speedboats from Koh Lanta to Phi Phi, Phuket, the islands and Langkawi.

dayItems.text: Koh Phi Phi at 9:30, then Phuket (Rassada pier) at 10:30.
Koh Ngai 11:10, Koh Mook 11:20, Koh Kradan 11:35, Koh Bulon 12:35 and Koh Lipe 13:30. From Koh Lipe a ferry goes on to Langkawi, arriving at 18:00 on Malaysian time.
Koh Phi Phi at 13:30, then Phuket at 14:30.

Koh Phi Phi at 15:00, then Phuket at 16:00. From December to April a second boat leaves at the same time for Krabi (15:35), Railay (15:50), Koh Yao Noi (16:15), Koh Yao Yai (16:25) and Ao Nang (16:35, last stretch by shared van).
Koh Ngai 15:40, Koh Mook 15:50 and Koh Kradan 16:10.

goodToKnow: Coming back to Koh Lanta: from Phuket at 8:30, 11:00 and 12:30, with a stop at Phi Phi, arriving at 10:00, 12:30 and 14:00. From Koh Kradan at 10:45 or 12:15 (Koh Mook 11:00 or 12:30, Koh Ngai 11:30 or 12:50), arriving at 12:00 or 13:30.
In high season, from Koh Yao Yai at 8:00, Koh Yao Noi 8:10, Railay 8:35, Ao Nang 7:50 and Krabi 8:50, arriving at Koh Lanta at 10:00.
Check in at the pier 30 minutes before departure, and 1h30 before for Langkawi, for the immigration check.

Times are for the 2026-2027 season and change with the weather and the sea. Some departures run all year, others from 15 October to 30 April. Langkawi runs from 1 November to 15 April, and Krabi, Ao Nang, Railay and Koh Yao from 1 December.
